Libraries the Windows app is built with, kept here so the source builds offline.
go-webview2 (MIT, https://github.com/jchv/go-webview2): changed for Reactio Draw (marked "Reactio Draw" in webview.go:
a close hook, access to the browser, the window created hidden; webviewloader loads WebView2Loader.dll from beside the exe).
golang.org/x/sys (BSD-3-Clause; only the parts the app uses: cpu, execabs, windows): unchanged.
The licenses are in their folders and in ../../LICENSES.
